About this hub

SHIZCON is the main storefront for the software built by Fayaz Ali, a developer and digital creator based in Karachi, Pakistan. His day-to-day work spans video editing, websites, blogging and YouTube — and this hub collects the software products that grew out of that work: tools he first built for his own channels, blogs and client projects, now packaged so other people and businesses can use them too.

The catalogue is deliberately practical. Jervis AI is a voice assistant that answers back, reports on the phone's battery, storage and network, and includes a Security Shield that checks suspicious links and messages before you act on them. Novex is an agent command center where AI agents handle blogging, YouTube, SEO and freelance work from one mobile-first dashboard. Shizco1 runs construction projects — budgets, timelines, daily site logs and materials — and is live today. The Restaurant & Hotel Management System — whose live demo is online now — brings the same approach to tables, orders, rooms and bookings. And the Free Tools Hub keeps ten everyday calculators and converters free for anyone, forever.

Everything listed here is real and honestly labelled: live products link to their working demos, products in development say so, and prices are either published on this page or quoted in writing before work starts. Several products — including the Al Asad Constructors website — are already deployed and in daily use.

Need something custom — a voice assistant for your business, a management system for your restaurant, hotel, school or office, or a complete website? Use the order form below and describe what you need. Every enquiry is answered personally.

Frequently asked questions

How do I buy the full software?
Choose a product, click Buy / Order, and send the enquiry form. It opens a pre-filled email to shizconenterprises@gmail.com. You will receive a written reply confirming the exact scope, total price, delivery time and payment method. Nothing is charged and nothing is final until you accept that written quote.
Can I try before I buy?
Yes. The Live Demos section lists every demo in one place — AI Agent Platform, the Restaurant & Hotel System demo, Moosa Enterprises, Free Tools Hub, Alasad Constructors, StudyHive9, Converters, the CGPA Tool, Novex, AI Map Planner and Shizco1 — each opening in a new tab. Jervis AI also has a working Security Shield demo on this page (open the Jervis details), and the Free Tools Hub card includes a working unit-converter demo.
What does "cloud storage" mean for Jervis AI with Storage and the management systems?
Those editions save data — tasks, approvals, settings, orders, bookings — in a database instead of only in your browser. Your information is still there when you reload the page or come back on another day, instead of starting empty every time.
Is the Restaurant & Hotel Management System ready?
Yes — its live demo is online now. Open it from the Live Demos section and try restaurant orders, kitchen flow, billing and table QR yourself. The hotel side (rooms, bookings, check-in/check-out, guests) is part of the same system; school and office modules follow. Send an enquiry for a full setup for your restaurant or hotel.
Can you build a custom version for my business?
Yes — most products here started as custom builds. A voice assistant with your own character, a management system for your restaurant, hotel, school or office, or a complete business website like the Alasad Constructors site can all be quoted. Describe the project in the order form.
Do the free tools collect my data?
No. The calculators and converters run entirely in your browser — the numbers you type are never sent anywhere or stored. See the Privacy Policy below for the full detail.

Privacy Policy & Terms

Privacy Policy

This website is a static information and storefront page. It does not run user accounts and does not collect, store or sell personal information through the page itself. The calculators, converters and the link checker run entirely in your own browser; the values you enter are never transmitted to us or stored.

When you use the order form, it opens your own email application with a pre-filled message addressed to shizconenterprises@gmail.com. Anything you choose to send in that email is used only to reply to your enquiry, prepare a quote, and — if you place an order — deliver and support your software. Your email address is not sold or shared with third parties for marketing.

This site may display advertising served by Google AdSense. Google and its partners may use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this and other websites. You can opt out of personalised advertising at any time via Google's Ads Settings (google.com/settings/ads). Links on this page lead to third-party sites such as GitHub and GitHub Pages, which have their own privacy policies.

Terms of Purchase

Product descriptions, features and prices on this page describe the software as offered at the time of writing. A purchase is only final when scope, total price, delivery time and payment method have been confirmed in writing (by email) and accepted by you. Software marked "in development" is not sold as a finished product; enquiries for it join an early-access list. Delivered software includes setup guidance as described in the product details; custom changes beyond the agreed scope are quoted separately.

Content & Accuracy

We work to keep statuses, prices and links on this page accurate and update them when products change. Demo links open the live public builds of the products named. If you find an error, please report it by email and it will be corrected.
